verdict.rationale: Belvo's Smart Collections lets you define balance conditions and collection amounts. Belvo then watches the account in the background and acts when those conditions are met, which is a real event-triggered rule capability. It is limited to one domain (balance-based Pix collections in Brazil) rather than a general rules engine, and webhooks and recurrent-link refreshes are notifications rather than user-defined rules. Missing for 10: a general-purpose user-defined rule/trigger engine across event types, documentation of the rule definition model and the range of actions, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: you tell Belvo the amounts you want to collect as well as the balance conditions to wait for and Belvo watches the account in the background
Automate balance-based Pix collections. Belvo monitors your user's balance and notifies you the moment there are enough funds to collect.
